difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four descent statements for maps of modules along a directed colimit: equality of two maps, surjectivity, the existence of a map from a finitely presented module, and being an isomorphism, all descend to a single stage (statement lines 32205-32230). The proof does not use a categorical presentability theorem: it spreads the finitely many generators or relations out to one index, uses a finite presentation of the target to build the map on a stage, and combines the parts (proof lines 32232-32275). The finite presentation of the target is exactly what makes part (3) possible. H2.
